candidate.answerReason: The condition 2x−6≥0 gives x≥3. Since 3 is an integer and makes the radicand zero, it is the smallest permitted integer.

methods.label: Find the domain and its least integer
methods.explanation: We require \(2x-6\ge0\), or \(x\ge3\). The smallest integer is 3.
